title: Polymer Property Prediction
description: Polymer property calculations using molecular simulation and machine learning potentials, particularly elastic response and density. I am interested in how preparation, stress analysis, sampling, and reference conditions affect the interpretation of these estimates.

title: Representation Learning for Molecular Dynamics
description: Molecular features and temporal information for physical prediction in atomistic and coarse-grained systems. My studies compare JEPA training, direct supervision, and simple dynamical baselines through matched prediction tasks and temporal-pairing controls.

title: Molecular Dynamics & Machine Learning Potentials
description: Learned interatomic interactions for molecular simulation, with interests in the application and computational efficiency of machine learning potentials.

title: Coarse-Grained Molecular Modeling
description: Reduced molecular descriptions that connect atomistic detail with modeling at larger length and time scales, and the information those descriptions retain about molecular dynamics.

title: AI for Materials
description: Machine learning for molecular and materials modeling, with an interest in the relationships between structure, dynamics, and macroscopic properties.

title: Computational Efficiency of ML Interatomic Potentials
description: Practical memory and runtime limits in polymer simulations motivate my interest in computational efficiency. My MACE resource pilot measured trade-offs in GPU allocation; developing an optimization method remains a research interest.
